big_case.notes: Twenty additional years of imprisonment and the interaction between plain-error review and section 2255 give this case substantial individual stakes and some broader doctrinal significance. The nonprecedential collateral ruling, unusual posture and absence of an identified circuit conflict limit its systemic reach.
